# BlankAI

> BlankAI is a browser-based image metadata cleaning tool. It creates a fresh local export that removes EXIF, XMP, IPTC, GPS, C2PA content credentials, and other hidden image metadata from supported files without uploading images to a server.

BlankAI is best understood as a privacy-first metadata remover, not a guarantee about every downstream platform label or detection system.

Primary use cases:
- Remove AI content credentials and hidden image metadata before publishing or sharing files.
- Inspect image metadata locally in the browser before deciding what to keep or remove.
- Compare original and cleaned exports to verify that the output changed.

Important product notes:
- Processing is browser-only for the main workflow. Images do not need to leave the device.
- The cleaned output is a fresh export, so file hashes and small encoding details may change.
- The site includes both end-user tools and educational guides about content credentials, C2PA, EXIF, and image metadata.

## Primary Tools

- [BlankAI Home](https://blankai.app/): Main image metadata remover. Upload images and create a fresh cleaned export without EXIF, XMP, IPTC, GPS, or C2PA content credentials.
- [Remove AI Content Credentials](https://blankai.app/remove-ai-content-credentials): Focused landing page for users specifically trying to remove AI content credentials or provenance metadata from images.
- [Image Metadata Remover](https://blankai.app/image-metadata-remover): Broader overview page for removing hidden image metadata, including EXIF, XMP, IPTC, C2PA, and AI-related tags.
- [EXIF Viewer](https://blankai.app/exif-viewer): Inspect image metadata locally in the browser, including EXIF, GPS, AI-related fields, and common provenance signals.
- [Image Diff](https://blankai.app/image-diff): Compare original and cleaned images to verify that the fresh export differs from the source file.

## Key Guides

- [What Are Content Credentials?](https://blankai.app/blog/what-are-content-credentials): Plain-language guide to content credentials, provenance labels, and how they differ from older metadata like EXIF.
- [What Is AI Metadata?](https://blankai.app/blog/what-is-ai-metadata-and-why-it-matters): Overview of the metadata and provenance layers commonly embedded in AI-generated images.
- [How to Remove C2PA Metadata](https://blankai.app/blog/how-to-remove-c2pa-metadata): Technical guide to C2PA manifests and why browser-side re-encoding removes file-level provenance data.
- [How to Remove EXIF Data from Images](https://blankai.app/blog/remove-exif-data-complete-guide): Guide to EXIF fields, privacy implications, and metadata-cleaning methods.
- [Midjourney Metadata Removal](https://blankai.app/blog/midjourney-metadata-removal): Guide to Midjourney-specific metadata and export cleanup considerations.
- [Stable Diffusion Metadata Guide](https://blankai.app/blog/stable-diffusion-metadata-guide): Guide to Stable Diffusion metadata such as prompts, seeds, and PNG text chunks.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://blankai.app/privacy): Explains the browser-only processing model and limited analytics collection.
- [Terms of Service](https://blankai.app/terms): Product terms, disclaimers, and service limitations.
